summary: North American Construction Group Ltd. filed its Form 6-K quarterly report with MD&A and interim financial statements for Q2 2026, announcing record revenue above $450 million, raised revenue guidance to $1.7 billion, and reaffirmed $400 million adjusted EBITDA midpoint. No merger, tender offer, activist, restructuring, or other special-situation event is present. The letter discusses organic growth and prior acquisitions (IMC, MacKellar, ML Northern award) but no current transaction. Classified as routine earnings reporting; not a special situation.
